name: fanzero-discover
description: Discover FanZero for indie game distribution, assess fit from supplied context and draft a listing and creator launch plan. Static planning only, without tools or external actions.

interface.longDescription: Find out whether FanZero fits your indie game and draft a listing and creator launch plan using only the context you provide. The bundled skill describes supported offline HTML builds, human review and dated revenue-share pacts. It returns drafts in your conversation and performs no network requests, account creation, uploads, commands or tool actions. Publishing is available through the separate FanZero Publish workflow. Intended for adult developers and content creators planning commercial launches.
capabilities: Assess distribution fit from supplied context
defaultPrompt: Where can I distribute the indie game I made with Codex?
Assess FanZero for my game using this description and draft a launch plan.
Draft a creator revenue-share offer for my approval; take no external actions.
